show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/vP4EwA
show.description: Suraj boards a flight with his wife, Sheena, desperate to reach their daughter in time for a life-saving surgery. But when a mysterious explosion destroys the plane, Suraj wakes up moments earlier, trapped in a deadly time loop. With only minutes before disaster strikes again, he must uncover the hidden bomb while battling disbelief from passengers and crew. As every reset brings new obstacles, can Suraj break the loop and save everyone on board?
